items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire
High School Graduate or High School GED
Completed and passed Surgical Scrub Technical Training or Obstetrical Technician Training for new hires as of 7/1/2009. 10 years recent OB Tech experience in lieu of formal training is acceptable
One (1) year experience as an OB Tech
Additional experience in providing care to neonates, children and adolescents. , upon hire

OBSERVATION OF PATIENTS: Continually observe patient needs by making rounds, and discussing patient needs with other staff members and family members. Assist nurses with care of patients. Supply patients with items needed for care of themself and their baby
Assist with maintaining infant security by educating families on security practices of unit, wearing appropriate identification and maintaining awareness of activities and visitors on the unit.
Communicate effectively and courteously with the patient/family member, FBC staff, ancillary staff, physicians.
Meets job expectations of job standards

Assisting with ambulation and transportation of patients when directed and it is appropriate. Promote the patient's right and need for privacy and maintain confidentiality. Provide emotional support for patients and their families by utilizing communication skills. Seek and accept direction from staff RN, NSM and Nurse Manager. Reporting significant changes in patients' condition to the RN, or Charge nurse immediately. Participate in quality assurance activities.
Can scrub, set up and maintain a sterile field and perform the duties of a OB Technologist for surgical procedures in the OB department.
